The initiative, which will see the construction of 500 new structures and restoration of 1,000 non-functional systems across government buildings by June 30th, aims to capture rainwater that would otherwise flow into drains. **Delhi Water Minister Parvesh Verma** emphasized the importance of continuous water conservation efforts, highlighting that every drop of rain is a valuable resource. The project is expected to recharge around 733 million liters of water annually and address concerns over declining groundwater levels in the city.

recent_articles.title: Why Congress Needs Overhaul In Punjab: Challenges Ahead Of 2027
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** secured a decisive victory in the Punjab local body elections, winning 958 seats and demonstrating strong dominance. The Congress party saw its seat count plummet from 1,399 to just 397, highlighting internal factionalism issues within the party. The **BJP** gained urban ground, increasing its seats from 49 to 172.  The Akali Dal also experienced a decline in its electoral performance.  The Congress High Command is preparing for significant changes within the Punjab unit, including potential replacements for the state president and leadership positions.

recent_articles.title: ‘She has kept the best room for herself’: Inside Harsh Beniwal’s lavish family home in Delhi | Art-and-culture News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Farah Khan**, **Harsh Beniwal**, and his family showcased their Delhi home in a recent video, highlighting how personal interiors can impact emotional comfort.  The living area featured warm neutral tones and open conversational seating arrangements, while the kitchen was spacious and organized. **Harsh Beniwal** discussed the pressure of online content creation and how it affects his mental health, revealing that he built a gaming room but rarely uses it due to family time. **Athul Raj**, a counselling psychologist, emphasizes that homes influence emotional well-being significantly, suggesting personalized spaces like cozy corners or quiet family lounges can reduce stress and create psychological comfort.

recent_articles.title: Delhi Records Coolest June Start In 3 Years With Below Normal Temperatures
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The national capital** experienced the coolest June 1st in three years, with **Safdarjung observatory** recording a maximum temperature of 36.3 degrees Celsius, 3.7 degrees below seasonal norm.  No rainfall was recorded across five monitoring stations over the past 24 hours. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) predicts temperatures to gradually rise from tomorrow as the current rain activity weakens.

recent_articles.title: ‘Old enough to pull trigger’: Delhi teen dies 4 days after being shot, family demands minor accused be tried as adult | The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 17-year-old boy, who was shot in the head outside a Delhi eatery on May 27th while with a friend, died from his injuries on Monday. **The victim's family** demanded that one of the accused, a 16-year-old juvenile, be tried as an adult.  **The Delhi Police Crime Branch** is investigating the case and is expected to add murder charges to the existing FIR. Two other suspects, aged 18 and 24, were arrested for the murder. An automatic pistol was recovered from the juvenile's possession.

recent_articles.title: ‘Make in Haryana’ Industrial Policy eyes future-ready industries with AI-driven ecosystem | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** launched the 'Make in Haryana' Industrial Policy, aiming to attract Rs 5 lakh crore in investments and position the state as a powerhouse for future-ready manufacturing. The policy focuses on data centers, GCCs, AI-driven investment facilitation, and emerging technologies. **Rao Narbir Singh**, the Industries and Commerce Minister, emphasized the need for speed and trust in attracting global investors.  **Anant Raj Limited** signed an MoU with the Haryana government to invest ₹20,000 crore in data center infrastructure, while other companies like **Reliance MET City** and **India Cellular and Electronics Association (ICEA)** also pledged investments.

recent_articles.title: India, Myanmar Vow Deeper Ties On Security, Trade And Connectivity
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Myanmar President U Min Aung Hlaing** met in New Delhi, where they pledged deeper cooperation in security, trade, and infrastructure.  **Modi** positioned Myanmar as a key partner in India's foreign policy initiatives, including Neighbourhood First, Act East, and MAHASAGAR. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity, while also emphasizing the importance of preventing misuse of sovereign territory for activities threatening national security. The visit included discussions on connectivity projects like the Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport project and the India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway, as well as trade facilitation and people-to-people initiatives.  **Modi** announced an expansion of scholarships for Myanmar students, while **Min Aung Hlaing** offered prayers at Buddhist sites in Bodh Gaya.

recent_articles.title: I came to know about my brother’s death only through Google search: Himachal Pradesh accident victim’s sister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jayanthashree G.**, sister of accident victim **Karthigeyan P.G.**, discovered her brother's death through his YouTube search history and news reports on Google after their taxi plunged into a 500-meter deep gorge in Himachal Pradesh. The incident occurred on May 29 while the families were traveling to Dalhousie for a National Taekwondo Competition.  **Karthigeyan**, who ran a food catering business, was accompanied by his wife **Manimala**, and their son **Nandan**.  The accident claimed the lives of seven people, including **Karthigeyan**'s family and other passengers.

recent_articles.title: Indian PM Modi meets Myanmar military gov’t leader in New Delhi | Narendra Modi News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi** met with **Myanmar’s military leader Min Aung Hlaing** in New Delhi, despite criticism from opposition groups.  **India** stated its policy is not intended to comment on the internal political arrangements in Myanmar and believes engagement is the best way forward. During their meeting, the leaders discussed trade, defense, security cooperation, border management, and regional issues. **India** and **Myanmar** also agreed to deepen collaboration across sectors, including trade, energy, and critical minerals, as well as accelerate major connectivity projects.
